text: Automatically trigger spreadsheet update and email alert to ward manager at 7:30 a.m. when a nurse saves a ward note
Send reminder emails to nurse and team leader at 10 a.m. if a note is not entered
Sync nurse-entered notes from InHealth to ShareSheet by 8 a.m. the next day
Flag connection failures to IT via email while allowing nurses to save notes locally
Provide care coordinator with daily ShareSheet report highlighting urgent or new assessment notes for task planning
Allow care coordinator to notify team leader of missing notes via a pre-filled message inside the system
Send team leader an alert at 10:15 a.m. with nurse name, patient name, note type, and due time for missing notes
Escalate unresolved missing notes to ward manager at 11 a.m. with detailed alert and dashboard priority
Allow ward manager to view summary dashboard showing notes entered, overdue notes, and nurses with missing notes including patient details
Enable ward manager to send messages directly to flagged nurses from the dashboard view
Display nurses' 'Today's Notes' dashboard on login with red flags for missing or overdue notes linking directly to note entry
Show real-time status line on nurse's note entry screen during ShareSheet sync retries, updating from 'Retrying' to 'Sent' without refresh
Automatically retry sending unsynced notes every 5 minutes for up to 30 minutes, then prompt nurse to contact IT if still failing
Keep duplicate note entries with timestamps and flag them as 'Duplicate entry — check for accuracy' in ShareSheet
Lock notes from editing after 48 hours unless a supervisor approves corrections, which are stored as new linked entries
Store and transmit all patient notes encrypted, log every access, and allow permanent deletion of notes within 72 hours upon patient request
Use the same login system as InHealth to avoid extra passwords for nurses
Log sync delays with timestamps and alert IT within 5 minutes of failure
Maintain full retry history of note sync attempts including save time, retry times, results, and final sync time for at least 90 days
Build the note-to-ShareSheet sync as an internal API service called by InHealth on note save, using JavaScript, .NET, and secure internal APIs
